visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair wears a pink headband with blue eye-like protrusions, applying white cream mask to her cheeks and forehead with a flat silver brush. She is wearing a black-and-white striped pajama shirt. A second woman stands closely behind her, watching. The setting is an indoor room with soft, warm lighting. (2) The scene shifts to a colorful exhibition space. The woman in a white tank top and jeans walks through a series of circular, character-themed arches. She poses with a peace sign in front of a large pink heart-shaped backdrop featuring 'KUROMI 20TH ANNIVERSARY'. (3) The woman poses with a giant black Kuromi character statue in a studio-like environment with graphic wall art. She then examines purple plush toys on a shelf in a brightly lit retail section. (4) Outdoors at dusk, the woman, now wearing a black leather jacket, talks to the camera while touching her cheek. Her friend joins her, and they hold a purple paper shopping bag. The background shows urban architecture and a walkway. (5) Close-up product shots feature APIVITA brand face mask sachets (Prickly Pear, Sea Lavender, Pomegranate, Pumpkin) being held and opened. Hands apply a yellow-tinted serum from a brown glass dropper bottle onto the skin. A green serum bottle is also shown being used. (6) A split-screen displays four different APIVITA mask sachets simultaneously being held up against a backdrop of Kuromi merchandise.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main creator and 1 female friend appearing throughout the vlog.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with shoulder-length black hair. She wears a striped pajama top at home, then changes into a white tank top, blue jeans, and eventually a black leather jacket.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Starts in a home interior with a mirror and soft lighting. Transitions to a Sanrio-themed exhibition (Kuromi 20th Anniversary) featuring character cutouts, merchandise shelves, and colorful neon tunnels. Ends in an outdoor paved plaza with historical-style brick buildings.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, bright synthesizer music begins with a strong 4/4 beat. A high-pitched female voice speaks quickly and excitedly. (2) A subtle 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the location shifts. Background sounds of cheering and light chatter are audible under the upbeat music. (3) A 'sparkle' sound effect accompanies the appearance of variety text on screen. The vocal tone is playful and energetic. (4) In the second half, the audio shifts to a clearer, more narrative-focused voiceover with the same speaker. Crisp 'crinkle' sounds of plastic sachets being opened and 'liquid drips' from the serum dropper are emphasized. (5) The music continues at a steady tempo until the end, concluding with a final brand mention and location info in an enunciated, professional tone.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Experience -> Product Integration -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a lifestyle vlog that promotes APIVITA skincare products by demonstrating their effectiveness in achieving a 'glowing, long-lasting makeup' look for a special event (the Kuromi 20th Anniversary exhibition). It combines the appeal of a trending character event with a practical beauty solution, ending with specific purchasing information.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The speaker explicitly names the brand APIVITA, shows multiple product close-ups, explains their benefits, and provides a direct call-to-action with group buy information and retail locations.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively bridges character-themed entertainment with beauty marketing. The high visual energy and fast-paced editing align with social media trends targeting young female consumers interested in both IP events and skincare.
